purpose: Identify useful cross-check and acquisition leads for foundational statutes. These links are not permission grants and secondary text must not be promoted to primary-source status.

evidence.finding: Useful for locating the base Civil Code and its bibliographic metadata. It does not establish a current consolidated version or complete amendment chain.
evidence.next_action: Use metadata to locate the original Gazette publication; separately identify all amendments and transitional provisions.

evidence.finding: Useful bibliographic cross-check for the base Penal Code. The platform marks it amended, so the original text alone cannot support current-law answers.
evidence.next_action: Locate original Gazette text, identify amendments and special penal statutes, and record offence-date / more-favourable-law temporal rules for lawyer review.

evidence.publisher: World Intellectual Property Organization — WIPO Lex
evidence.observed_title: Law No. 82 of 2002 on the Protection of Intellectual Property Rights, Egypt
evidence.finding: WIPO Lex describes an Arabic consolidated text amended through Law 178/2020 and identifies other amendment instruments. Because the consolidation stops in 2020, it is a valuable amendment-history starting point but not proof of current 2026 status.
evidence.next_action: Review WIPO terms before any reuse; obtain Gazette texts for Law 178/2020 and listed earlier amendments, then search for amendments after September 2020.

evidence.publisher: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
evidence.source_class: government-hosted reference PDF / version not established
evidence.finding: Government-hosted reference copy may help identify the law's structure, but its consolidated-through date and amendment completeness are not established from the discovery result.
evidence.next_action: Check document cover/metadata and compare against WIPO Lex and the Official Gazette; do not treat it as current without version review.

evidence.observed_title: قانون تنظيم الشهر العقاري رقم 114 لسنة 1946
evidence.finding: Useful bibliographic lead for Law 114/1946 and its implementing regulation. The source labels the law amended, so this is not a current consolidated text.
evidence.next_action: Locate the original Gazette and implementing regulation, map each amendment, and separately cover Law 68/1947 on notarization.

evidence.observed_title: قانون إنشاء محاكم الأسرة رقم 10 لسنة 2004
evidence.finding: Useful metadata for locating the original family-courts law and related amendments. The platform marks the law amended.
evidence.next_action: Locate the original Gazette, identify all amending instruments and related personal-status procedures, and obtain family-lawyer review.

evidence.observed_title: Law No. 174 of 2025 on the Issuance of the Criminal Procedure Law
evidence.finding: Useful to locate the 2025 enactment but predates Law 160/2026, which official source discovery indicates changed the commencement date. This record must not be used alone to describe current operative status.
evidence.next_action: Review ILO terms, acquire authorized Gazette texts for both Laws 174/2025 and 160/2026, and obtain criminal-procedure counsel sign-off.

evidence.publisher: Ministry of Justice Gazette PDF compared with Manshurat
evidence.source_class: official text versus secondary transcription discrepancy
evidence.observed_title_ar: قانون الإجراءات الجنائية 174 لسنة 2025 — المادة الثانية من مواد الإصدار
evidence.finding: Official Gazette PDF reads مواد الجنايات; Manshurat full text reads مواد الجنح. Use the Gazette wording for the official-text field and preserve the secondary variant in the audit trail.
evidence.next_action: Visually collate the Gazette page image, save authorized original/hash and obtain Egyptian lawyer confirmation.

evidence.publisher: Masaar full Arabic text with regulatory cross-check
evidence.source_class: secondary full text and Gazette metadata cross-check
evidence.observed_title_ar: قرار رئيس مجلس الوزراء رقم 1699 لسنة 2020
evidence.finding: PM Decree 1699/2020 is supported by Gazette metadata and full Arabic text. An ESCC-hosted PDF path previously surfaced with header 635/2020; it is quarantined and not accepted as the implementing regulation pending provenance clarification.

evidence.publisher: Egyptian Drug Authority official schedule index
evidence.source_class: official regulator index and Gazette PDFs
evidence.observed_title_ar: قراري وزير الصحة والسكان 44 لسنة 2026 و242 لسنة 2026
evidence.finding: Decision 44/2026 replaced all schedules annexed to Law 182/1960; Decision 242/2026 subsequently replaces item 12 in Table 1 section I(B) and amends Table 3. The earlier unverified status for 242 is superseded.
evidence.next_action: OCR all schedules from both official EDA PDFs, preserve version snapshots and effective dates, and obtain the cited SCC judgment.

evidence.observed_title_ar: القانون رقم 14 لسنة 2022 بتعديل بعض أحكام قانون تنظيم السجون
evidence.finding: Art. 2 replaces the statute title with في شأن تنظيم السجون while replacement Art. 1 uses مراكز الإصلاح والتأهيل for facilities. The prior blanket statement that the law was renamed to correction centres is inaccurate.
evidence.next_action: Visually collate the Gazette page and keep statute title separate from facility terminology.

evidence.publisher: Supreme Constitutional Court-hosted Official Gazette PDF
evidence.observed_title_ar: قانون حماية البيانات الشخصية 151 لسنة 2020 — المادة الثالثة من مواد الإصدار
evidence.finding: Issuance Art. 3(4) excludes data relating to police reports, investigations and judicial proceedings from the attached Data Protection Law. Art. 34 grants judicial-police status to designated Centre staff.
evidence.next_action: Extract all 49 law articles and Decision 816/2025; review interplay with Law 175/2018 and sectoral retention/disclosure rules.

guardrails: A secondary database page is a discovery/cross-check source, not the authoritative publication record.
A label such as 'amended' does not identify every amendment or prove the current consolidated wording.
A text consolidated only through 2020 must be treated as potentially stale for 2026.
Do not bulk download, scrape, or reuse any source without reviewing access terms and permission for the intended use.
Do not promote any entry to acquired, verified, or in-force based only on these leads.
